audit.why: Early Pantheon lane that flips at 6 and out-scales after — 60.1% WR shows the flip is real; prose already tells that story.
Spikes present: his 1-5 window, your level 6 flip, first-item even, late outscale.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases 2-4 read Skill while content and packet say Pantheon, and row 7 reads Skill vs content Swain; cooldowns field had no digits; the Nevermove-cancels-Aegis-channel interaction was never stated.
audit.why: Shield Vault is 13/12/11/10/9s, Aegis Assault 22s and a front-only channel that Swain's root cancels — that is the decisive interaction the page missed.
audit.corrected: Chart aligned, real cooldowns and the E-cancels-E line added.

edits.before: E online: the root that defines the lane. Land it and the Q follow-up chunks; miss it and you farm for fourteen seconds.
edits.after: His W stun plus Q poke is a point-and-click trade your slow Nevermove cannot answer — level 2 is his. Farm at max range.

edits.before: W completes the setup: vision + slow from across the map. Root-into-W never misses, and the passive soul fragments heal you.
edits.after: Level 3 completes his W-Q-auto all-in before your ult exists — he controls every trade. Hug tower and hold E for the jump.

edits.before: Lost Chapter timing — Q-spam stops costing the lane. Poke the wave contact and pull every rooted target with the passive.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 stay his window: the burst combo is online and your E is too slow to peel a committed jump. Concede CS, reach 6.

edits.before: Late Swain is the anti-team: flank-root their engage, ascend in their backline, and demonflare the clump that forms around you.
edits.after: Two items in you outscale him hard — his lethality stops one-shotting while your R uptime and E-Q AoE anchor every teamfight.

edits.before: - Pantheon Shield Vault (Stun): matchup-defining — Point-and-click stun — respect the all-in any time it is up. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget E Nevermove for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Shield Vault is 13s at rank 1: point-and-click stun — respect the all-in any time it is up and step forward only on its downtime. - His E Aegis runs 22s and only blocks the front — your Nevermove cancels the channel outright.

edits.before: E his step-up, passive-pull the root for the chunk + heal, Q the retreat — every landed root is a won trade with a health refund attached.
edits.after: In R form you drain minions too — drag the brawl through your own wave so every body feeds the heal while his combo hits one target.

edits.before: Brawling pre-6 like the demon is already online — Swain without R is a slow mage with a dream and a root on cooldown.
edits.after: Every few spells or attacks arm Mortal Will — trading autos hands him an empowered W or Q that chunks you for free.
